Operations.Name: FtpUpdate
Operations.Description:
Update ftp service configuration.

`clients` is an integer value which sets the maximum number of simultaneous clients allowed. It defaults to 32.

`ipconnections` is an integer value which shows the maximum number of connections per IP address. It defaults
to 0 which equals to unlimited.

`timeout` is the maximum number of seconds that proftpd will allow clients to stay connected without receiving
any data on either the control or data connection.

`timeout_notransfer` is the maximum number of seconds a client is allowed to spend connected, after
authentication, without issuing a command which results in creating an active or passive data connection
(i.e. sending/receiving a file, or receiving a directory listing).

`onlyanonymous` allows anonymous FTP logins with access to the directory specified by `anonpath`.

`banner` is a message displayed to local login users after they successfully authenticate. It is not displayed
to anonymous login users.

`filemask` sets the default permissions for newly created files which by default are 077.

`dirmask` sets the default permissions for newly created directories which by default are 077.

`resume` if set allows FTP clients to resume interrupted transfers.

`fxp` if set to true indicates that File eXchange Protocol is enabled. Generally it is discouraged as it
makes the server vulnerable to FTP bounce attacks.

`defaultroot` when set ensures that for local users, home directory access is only granted if the user
is a member of group wheel.

`ident` is a boolean value which when set to true indicates that IDENT authentication is required. If identd
is not running on the client, this can result in timeouts.

`masqaddress` is the public IP address or hostname which is set if FTP clients cannot connect through a
NAT device.

`localuserbw` is a positive integer value which indicates maximum upload bandwidth in KB/s for local user.
Default of zero indicates unlimited upload bandwidth ( from the FTP server configuration ).

`localuserdlbw` is a positive integer value which indicates maximum download bandwidth in KB/s for local user.
Default of zero indicates unlimited download bandwidth ( from the FTP server configuration ).

`anonuserbw` is a positive integer value which indicates maximum upload bandwidth in KB/s for anonymous user.
Default of zero indicates unlimited upload bandwidth ( from the FTP server configuration ).

`anonuserdlbw` is a positive integer value which indicates maximum download bandwidth in KB/s for anonymous
user. Default of zero indicates unlimited download bandwidth ( from the FTP server configuration ).

`tls` is a boolean value which when set indicates that encrypted connections are enabled. This requires a
certificate to be configured first with the certificate service and the id of certificate is passed on in
`ssltls_certificate`.

`tls_policy` defines whether the control channel, data channel, both channels, or neither channel of an FTP
session must occur over SSL/TLS.

`tls_opt_enable_diags` is a boolean value when set, logs verbosely. This is helpful when troubleshooting a
connection.

`options` is a string used to add proftpd(8) parameters not covered by ftp service.

Fields.Name: Anonpath
Fields.Description: Filesystem path for anonymous FTP users. `null` to use the default anonymous FTP directory.

Fields.Name: Anonuserbw
Fields.Description: Maximum upload bandwidth in KiB/s for anonymous users. 0 means unlimited.

Fields.Name: Anonuserdlbw
Fields.Description: Maximum download bandwidth in KiB/s for anonymous users. 0 means unlimited.

Fields.Name: Banner
Fields.Description: Welcome message displayed to FTP clients upon connection.

Fields.Name: Clients
Fields.Description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

Fields.Name: Defaultroot
Fields.Description: Whether to restrict users to their home directories (chroot jail).

Fields.Name: Dirmask
Fields.Description: Default Unix permissions (umask) for directories created by FTP users.

Fields.Name: Filemask
Fields.Description: Default Unix permissions (umask) for files created by FTP users.

Fields.Name: Fxp
Fields.Description: Whether to enable File eXchange Protocol (FXP) for server-to-server transfers.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Placeholder identifier.  Not used as there is only one.

Fields.Name: Ident
Fields.Description: Whether to perform RFC 1413 ident lookups on connecting clients.

Fields.Name: Ipconnections
Fields.Description: Maximum number of connections allowed from a single IP address. 0 means unlimited.

Fields.Name: Localuserbw
Fields.Description: Maximum upload bandwidth in KiB/s for local users. 0 means unlimited.

Fields.Name: Localuserdlbw
Fields.Description: Maximum download bandwidth in KiB/s for local users. 0 means unlimited.

Fields.Name: Loginattempt
Fields.Description: Maximum number of failed login attempts before blocking an IP address. 0 disables this limit.

Fields.Name: Masqaddress
Fields.Description: Public IP address to advertise to clients for passive mode connections when behind NAT.

Fields.Name: Onlyanonymous
Fields.Description: Whether to allow only anonymous FTP access, disabling authenticated user login.

Fields.Name: Onlylocal
Fields.Description: Whether to allow only local system users to login, disabling anonymous access.

Fields.Name: Options
Fields.Description: Additional ProFTPD configuration directives to include in the server configuration.     Manual directives may render the FTP service non-functional and should be used with caution.

Fields.Name: Passiveportsmax
Fields.Description: Maximum port number for passive mode data connections. Must be 0 or between 1024-65535.

Fields.Name: Passiveportsmin
Fields.Description: Minimum port number for passive mode data connections. Must be 0 or between 1024-65535.

Fields.Name: Port
Fields.Description: TCP port number on which the FTP service listens for incoming connections.

Fields.Name: Resume
Fields.Description: Whether to allow clients to resume interrupted file transfers.

Fields.Name: Reversedns
Fields.Description: Whether to perform reverse DNS lookups on client IP addresses for logging.

Fields.Name: SsltlsCertificate
Fields.Description: ID of the certificate to use for TLS/SSL connections. `null` to use the default system certificate.

Fields.Name: Timeout
Fields.Description: Idle timeout in seconds before disconnecting inactive clients. 0 disables timeout.

Fields.Name: TimeoutNotransfer
Fields.Description: Timeout in seconds for clients that connect but do not transfer data. 0 disables timeout.

Fields.Name: Tls
Fields.Description: Whether to enable TLS/SSL encryption for FTP connections.

Fields.Name: TlsOptAllowClientRenegotiations
Fields.Description: Whether to allow TLS clients to initiate renegotiation of the TLS connection.

Fields.Name: TlsOptAllowDotLogin
Fields.Description: Whether to allow .ftpaccess files to override TLS requirements for specific users.

Fields.Name: TlsOptAllowPerUser
Fields.Description: Whether to allow per-user TLS configuration overrides.

Fields.Name: TlsOptCommonNameRequired
Fields.Description: Whether to require client certificates to have a Common Name field.

Fields.Name: TlsOptDnsNameRequired
Fields.Description: Whether to require client certificates to contain a DNS name in the Subject Alternative Name extension.     The `reversedns` setting must also be enabled.

Fields.Name: TlsOptEnableDiags
Fields.Description: Whether to enable detailed TLS diagnostic logging.

Fields.Name: TlsOptExportCertData
Fields.Description: Whether to export client certificate data to environment variables.

Fields.Name: TlsOptIpAddressRequired
Fields.Description: Whether to require client certificates to contain an IP address in the Subject Alternative Name extension.

Fields.Name: TlsOptNoEmptyFragments
Fields.Description: Whether to disable empty TLS record fragments to improve compatibility with some clients.      Disabling increases vulnerability to some attack vectors.

Fields.Name: TlsOptNoSessionReuseRequired
Fields.Description: Whether to disable the requirement for TLS session reuse.

Fields.Name: TlsOptStdenvvars
Fields.Description: Whether to export standard TLS environment variables for use by external programs.

Fields.Name: TlsPolicy
Fields.Description: TLS policy for connections. Values include: `"on"` (required), `"off"` (disabled), `"data"` (data only),     `"auth"` (authentication only), `"ctrl"` (control only), or combinations with `+` and `!` modifiers.
